```text
usage: drg task status <task-id>
```

Tell whether the agent on a task is working, needs babysitting, fucked up, got shit done or never got going.

A finished run is recorded on the task.

The task ID may be the short one a listing prints, as long as it names a single task.

## Arguments

- `<task-id>`
